what: bounded digital-gain ladder at 115 cm, bypass vs cancel, four levels, one frozen source

deviations_reported.observation_length: the captain asked for 10 s per level; the driver caps the source at 131072 samples (2.68 s) and the capture is the last 16384 frames, so each level runs 2.6 s with the source active through the whole capture window
deviations_reported.steps: requested steps were -8, -5, -2, 0 dB; the last step is 3 dB because 0 dB is the ceiling

boundaries.bypass: highest completed -5.0 dB, first anomaly -2.0 dB -> boundary in (-5, -2]
boundaries.cancel: highest completed -2.0 dB, first anomaly 0.0 dB -> boundary in (-2, 0]
boundaries.difference: the canceller survives roughly one 3 dB step beyond bypass at this geometry

protection_state: bit22 = 0 and all four saturating counters 0 at every level in both modes; the anomalies were identified by narrowband growth (tonality > 12 dB), not by protection
candidate_working_gain: cancel: highest confirmed usable -2 dB minus 3 dB = -5 dB, still to be confirmed with live speech
not_claimed: no MSG/ASG figure (3 dB steps cannot resolve it)
audible gain and listener SPL not measured
